description: Use this to check a drawing started with start_cad_drawing (or one of list_my_cad_drawings): status, what the drafter says, room names, a preview image, the studio link and, when the account allows, DXF, DWG and PDF download links (valid for 10 minutes; call again for fresh ones). While it is still drawing this waits up to wait_seconds for it to finish.

drawing_id.description: The id from start_cad_drawing or list_my_cad_drawings.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a running drawing to finish before answering.

name: get_cad_drawing
title: Get a CAD drawing
